items.title_zh: 富士通客户端计算推出电影《哥斯拉-0.0》联名 FMV Zero Note U 笔电
items.title_en: Fujitsu launches Godzilla-0.0-themed FMV Zero Note U laptop
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，富士通客户端计算 (FCCL) 今日发布了 2026 年冬季新品，其中就包括了与即将上映的电影《哥斯拉-0.0》联名的 FMV Zero Note U 笔电 WU3G-L3。 该机型属于 FMV Note U 家族，其中就包含了质量仅有 634g 的超轻机型；名称中的 Zero 代表其属于 FCCL 第一方电商平台销售产品且采用纯黑配色方案。 《哥斯拉-0.0》联名型号 A 面为墨色的哥斯拉形象；C 面触控板印有哥斯拉背鳍图案，回车键上印有“G-0.0”标志；D 面拥有限定铭牌贴纸；预装 3 张独家原创壁纸与哥斯拉脚印光标主题；随附主题电源适配器。 该联名型号拥有全镁合金机身，可选 AMD 锐龙 AI 7 445 / 5 430 处理器，配备 14.0" WUXGA 屏幕，集成 63Whr 电池，质量 886g。 FMV Note U 家族此次得到大幅扩展， 覆盖英特尔、AMD、高通芯片平台 ，还包括与 KDDI 合作的支持蜂窝网络的版本。 相关阅读： 《 日本首部 IMAX 拍摄电影：〈哥斯拉-0.0〉终极预告公布，应战经典宿敌基多拉 》
items.summary_en: Fujitsu Client Computing (FCCL) announced a Godzilla-0.0-themed FMV Zero Note U laptop, model WU3G-L3, as part of its winter 2026 lineup. The 886g all-magnesium model has a 14.0-inch WUXGA display, 63Whr battery, and AMD Ryzen AI 7 445 or 5 430 options, with Godzilla artwork, a dorsal-fin touchpad, G-0.0 Enter key, limited nameplate, themed wallpapers/cursor and adapter. The FMV Note U family also expands across Intel, AMD and Qualcomm platforms, including a KDDI cellular version.
items.why_zh: 联名设计将热门电影 IP 带入轻薄笔电，同时体现富士通在芯片平台和蜂窝连接上的产品扩展。
items.why_en: The tie-in brings a hit film IP to a lightweight laptop while showing Fujitsu's expansion across chip platforms and cellular connectivity.

items.title_zh: 工信部 NVDB 发布关于防范 PHP 远程代码执行超危漏洞的风险提示
items.title_en: China's NVDB warns of two ultra-critical PHP RCE vulnerabilities
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，近日，工业和信息化部网络安全威胁和漏洞信息共享平台（NVDB）监测发现，PHP 存在两个远程代码执行超危漏洞，危害严重。 PHP 是一款广泛用于 Web 开发的开源服务器端脚本语言。由于其存在两个超危远程代码执行漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用其远程执行任意代码，造成服务器受控、敏感信息泄露、业务中断等危害。受影响的 PHP 范围包括：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。 目前，PHP 安全团队已修复漏洞并发布安全公告（URL 链接： https://www.php.net/ archive/ 2026.php#2026-10-21-5 ）。建议相关单位和用户立即开展全面排查，及时升级至最新安全版本，或采取临时下线、关闭会话上传进度功能、网络隔离、网络访问限制等临时防护措施；加强网络安全监测和管理，及时修改账号、口令和密钥等凭证，防范网络攻击风险。 相关阅读： 《 影响约 70% 网站：PHP 高危漏洞被修复，OpenAI 牵头协调全球发现 / 修复 》 《 为预防 PHP 安全漏洞，芬兰政府临时关闭部分网站 》 《 PHP 将推补丁修复两个 9.2 分漏洞，欧盟敦促无法及时修复的机构下线受影响网站 》 《 9.2 评分：PHP 拉响安全警报，今天将…
items.summary_en: China's MIIT NVDB issued a risk alert over two ultra-critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated attackers to run arbitrary code, potentially leading to server takeover, sensitive data leaks and service disruption. Affected versions include PHP 8.5 before 8.5.12, 8.4 before 8.4.27, 8.3 before 8.3.36, 8.2 before 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier. PHP has released fixes; NVDB urges immediate patching or temporary mitigations such as taking services offline, disabling session upload progress, network isolation and access restrictions.
items.why_zh: PHP 广泛用于 Web 开发，超危 RCE 漏洞可能影响大量服务器，需尽快升级或采取临时防护。
items.why_en: PHP is widely used in web development, so ultra-critical RCE flaws could affect many servers and require urgent patching or mitigation.

items.title_zh: 谷歌 Google Cloud 计划部署至多 96 万块 GPU 的英伟达 Vera Rubin 平台
items.title_en: Google Cloud Plans Up to 960,000 Nvidia Vera Rubin GPUs Across Sites
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，Google（谷歌）云服务业务 Google Cloud 当地时间 21 日宣布，其计划将基于 NVIDIA（英伟达）Vera Rubin 平台的基础设施扩展到多个算力站点， 最多可部署 96 万个 Rubin GPU 。 Google Cloud 同日表示，其基于 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 机架级系统的 A5X 实例正式上线。该实例采用了 NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNIC 以及 Google Cloud 的 Virgo 网络和第四代先进液冷技术，将于下个月正式推出。 其它方面，Google Cloud 将成为首批在裸机实例上提供机架级 NVIDIA 机密计算服务的云服务提供商之一。此外，谷歌云还将在搭载 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器版本 GPU 的 G4 虚拟机上正式推出机密计算服务。
items.summary_en: Google Cloud announced plans to expand Nvidia Vera Rubin-based infrastructure across multiple compute sites, with capacity for up to 960,000 Rubin GPUs. Its A5X instances built on Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale systems are now available, using ConnectX-9 SuperNIC, Google's Virgo network and fourth-generation liquid cooling, with general launch next month. Google Cloud also plans rack-scale Nvidia confidential computing on bare-metal instances and confidential computing on G4 VMs with RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs.
items.why_zh: 近百万GPU级部署凸显AI算力军备竞赛升级，也表明液冷与机密计算正成为云基础设施的重要能力。
items.why_en: A near-million-GPU deployment underscores the escalating AI compute arms race and shows liquid cooling and confidential computing becoming core cloud infrastructure capabilities.

items.title_zh: 5 年内产量翻番：马斯克称特斯拉目标 2030 实现年产量破 500 万辆
items.title_en: Musk Says Tesla Aims to Exceed 5 Million Vehicles a Year by 2030
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，科技媒体 breakingthenews 今天（10 月 22 日）发布博文，报道称在最新财报电话会议上，特斯拉首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）表示， 公司有望在 2030 年实现年产量突破 500 万辆。 马斯克表示特斯拉“已经为更大规模制造能力打下基础”，并认为“有很好的机会实现这一目标”。IT之家援引博文介绍，根据特斯拉第三季度财报资料， 公司目前年产能约为 240 万辆 ；若 2030 年达到 500 万辆，相当于产能翻倍。 马斯克强调，当前特斯拉车辆需求“正在快速增长”，并且“明显超过产能”。公司正在通过提升现有工厂生产节奏、扩建柏林工厂、在得州推进 Cybercab 量产，以及启动新的 Semi 工厂等方式增加产能。 财报电话会还披露，特斯拉第三季度交付 486,532 辆汽车，管理层称交付主要受产能而非需求限制，未交付订单积压达到近四年高位。马斯克将需求增长部分归因于完全自动驾驶（FSD）软件，并称公司将继续推动 FSD 在欧洲等更多市场获得批准。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk said on Tesla's earnings call that the company could reach annual production of more than 5 million vehicles by 2030, roughly double its current capacity of about 2.4 million. Tesla is expanding output by speeding up existing plants, expanding Berlin, ramping Cybercab in Texas and building a new Semi factory. Q3 deliveries reached 486,532 units, with management saying output rather than demand was the constraint and the order backlog hitting a near four-year high.
items.why_zh: 产量翻番目标将检验特斯拉的制造扩张能力，也反映其押注FSD带动需求增长。
items.why_en: The doubling target will test Tesla's manufacturing scale-up and reflects its bet that FSD will help drive demand.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，LG Display 今日发布 2026 财年（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 12 月）第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）业绩快报报告： 营业总收入 ：6.28 万亿韩元，同比下降 10%，环比增长 12% 归母净利润： 7467.47 亿韩元，同比扭亏为盈 合并净利润： 7556.35 亿韩元，同比增长 60496% 营业利润： 2505.68 亿韩元，同比下降 42%，环比扭亏为盈 AI 解读 本次财报业绩符合市场预期，归母净利润大幅同比增长超出市场预期。 公司主营业务说明 LG Display 是全球领先的显示面板制造商，主要生产 LCD、OLED 显示面板，产品应用于电视、笔记本电脑、显示器、汽车电子、移动设备等领域。 本次财报核心业绩亮点 营业收入：6.28 万亿韩元，环比增长 12%，同比下降 10%。 归属于母公司股东的净利润：7467.47 亿韩元，去年同期亏损 206.58 亿韩元，同比扭亏为盈； 合并净利润：7556.35 亿韩元，同比增长 60496%，去年同期为 12.47 亿韩元。 营业利润：第三季度营业利润为 2505.68 亿韩元，同比下降 42%，上季度亏损 1077.28 亿韩元，环比扭亏为盈。 未来展望与信息披露安排 本次业绩为初步快报数据，最终数据可能存在调整，业绩说明会已于 2026…
items.summary_en: LG Display reported preliminary Q3 FY2026 results: revenue of KRW 6.28 trillion, down 10% YoY but up 12% QoQ; net profit attributable to shareholders of KRW 746.747 billion, turning profitable from a year-earlier loss; consolidated net profit of KRW 755.635 billion; and operating profit of KRW 250.568 billion, down 42% YoY but turning profitable QoQ. The company said results met market expectations, with attributable net profit beating expectations; final figures may be adjusted.
items.why_zh: 财报显示 LG Display 同比扭亏为盈，反映显示面板行业盈利修复与公司经营改善。
items.why_en: The swing to profitability signals improving earnings in the display panel sector and better operating performance at LG Display.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek据报完成千亿人民币融资 挑战美国巨头
items.title_en: Zaobao: DeepSeek Reportedly Completes RMB 100 Billion Financing to Challenge U.S. Giants
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek据报完成千亿人民币融资 挑战美国巨头 联合早报
items.summary_en: Lianhe Zaobao reports that DeepSeek has reportedly completed about RMB 100 billion in financing, seen as a major capital move by a Chinese AI company to challenge U.S. leaders. The report focuses on the scale and competitive implications but lacks a full investor list, valuation and official response. If confirmed, the funds could expand model training, compute procurement and talent investment.
items.why_zh: 中国大模型公司以超大额融资缩小与美企的资本差距，竞争进入资本与算力密集阶段。
items.why_en: A Chinese LLM company is using mega-financing to narrow the capital gap with U.S. firms, as competition becomes more capital- and compute-intensive.

items.title_zh: 据报DeepSeek在最新一轮融资中筹集1,000亿元人民币
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Raises 100 Billion Yuan in Latest Round
items.summary_zh: 据报DeepSeek在最新一轮融资中筹集1,000亿元人民币 富途牛牛
items.summary_en: Futu and other media, citing reports, say DeepSeek raised 100 billion yuan in its latest round with Tencent and CATL participating, at a pre-money valuation of 500 billion yuan. The parties have not publicly confirmed the terms. Attention is now on how the funds will be used for model research, compute and talent.
items.why_zh: 融资规模凸显大模型公司对算力和人才的巨额投入需求。
items.why_en: The scale highlights the massive compute and talent spending required by foundation-model companies.

items.title_zh: 外媒：DeepSeek完成约1000亿人民币新一轮融资
items.title_en: Foreign Media: DeepSeek Completes New Round of About RMB 100 Billion
items.summary_zh: 外媒：DeepSeek完成约1000亿人民币新一轮融资 电子工程专辑
items.summary_en: EE Times China, citing foreign media, reports that DeepSeek has completed a new financing round of about RMB 100 billion. The excerpt focuses on the scale but does not disclose specific investors, valuation, use of funds or official confirmation. If verified, it would be one of the largest AI model financing rounds and could affect expectations for U.S.-China AI competition.
items.why_zh: 融资规模本身具有风向标意义，反映资本对大模型长期投入与商业前景的判断。
items.why_en: The size of the round is a bellwether for how capital views long-term LLM investment and commercialization prospects.

items.title_zh: StochIKM：从已发表 Kaplan-Meier 曲线自动高保真重建个体患者数据
items.title_en: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
items.summary_zh: arXiv 论文提出 StochIKM，用于从已发表的 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线自动重建个体患者数据（IPD）。作者指出，现有方法虽都宣称高保真，但各自采用不同的一致性标准，并且只返回单一数据集，而图像到数据的映射并非一一对应。论文明确给出“可采纳数据集”的保真度定义：需精确复现风险表、在图像分辨率范围内贴合数字化曲线，并满足其他约束（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respec…
items.why_zh: IPD 是生存分析二次研究的金标准，自动化重建可提升证据合成与可复现性。
items.why_en: IPD is the gold standard for secondary survival analysis, and automated reconstruction can improve evidence synthesis and reproducibility.

items.title_zh: CompLit：科研文献检索基准必须覆盖隐含、累积与未满足需求
items.title_en: CompLit: Scientific Literature Search Benchmarks Must Cover Implicit, Cumulative, and Unmet Needs
items.summary_zh: arXiv 论文指出，科研人员检索文献时往往用自身语言描述需求，论文可能只隐含地体现这些需求；随着阅读深入，需求会累积增长；而真正想找的内容还可能处于尚无论文覆盖的空白区域。为此，作者提出 CompLit 基准，覆盖 arXiv 八个领域，并为隐含、累积和未满足需求分别设置诊断场景。论文还评估了 Codex（GPT-5.6-Sol）与 Claude Code（Opus 4.8）等最强 agent，摘要在此处截断，未给出完整结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. We introduce CompLit, a literature search benchmark spanning all eight arXiv domains, with one diagnostic setting for each of these needs. The strongest agents, Codex (GPT-5.6-Sol) and Claude Code (Opus 4.8), answer…
items.why_zh: 更真实的文献检索基准能检验 AI 科研助手是否理解研究意图，而非只做关键词匹配。
items.why_en: More realistic literature-search benchmarks test whether AI research assistants understand research intent rather than merely matching keywords.

items.title_zh: VHDLBench：面向VHDL芯片设计的大模型评测与微调基准
items.title_en: VHDLBench: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for VHDL-Based Chip Design
items.summary_zh: 随着数字电路复杂度快速攀升，硬件设计自动化亟需新方法，但大语言模型在硬件描述语言生成、尤其是VHDL上的应用仍少有探索。该论文构建了包含1.85万余条经语法校验样本的VHDL数据集，数据取自开源代码仓库，并在此基础上系统评测与微调LLM，用于AI辅助数字电路设计。研究填补了当前电子设计自动化（EDA）流程中LLM能力评估的空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28676v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid evolution of digital circuit complexity demands innovative approaches to hardware design automation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have influenced software development, their application to Hardware Description Language (HDL) generation remains largely unexplored, particularly for VHDL. This paper presents a comprehensive study for AI-assisted digital circuit design, addressing gaps in current Electronic Design Automation workflows. The work introduces a VHDL dataset of 18,500+ syntax-verified examples from open-source repositori…
items.why_zh: 为LLM进入芯片前端设计这一高价值场景提供了可复现的数据与评测基础。
items.why_en: It provides a reproducible data and evaluation foundation for applying LLMs to chip front-end design.

items.title_zh: 面向临床与可穿戴健康数据的单位感知差分隐私量子机器学习
items.title_en: Unit-Aware Differentially Private Quantum Machine Learning for Clinical and Wearable Health Data
items.summary_zh: 临床登记数据与可穿戴传感器有助于早期健康风险评估，但在这些记录上训练的模型一旦发布，可能泄露敏感信息。差分隐私通过注入噪声来限制泄露，然而噪声总量随可训练参数增加而上升，对样本量小的健康队列尤为不利。这促使研究者转向量子机器学习等参数高效模型——其变分电路可用较少参数刻画复杂决策边界。论文据此探讨单位感知的差分隐私量子机器学习方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28968v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Clinical registries and wearable sensors support early health-risk assessment, yet models trained on these records may leak sensitive information when released. Differential privacy (DP) bounds this leakage by injecting noise whose total magnitude grows with the number of trainable parameters, a cost especially severe for small health cohorts. This motivates parameter efficient models including quantum machine learning (QML), whose variational circuits can represent complex decision boundaries with few trainable parameters. It raises a question…
items.why_zh: 在小样本健康数据上，为隐私保护与模型效用之间的权衡提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a new direction for balancing privacy and utility when modeling small health cohorts.

items.title_zh: 混合CNN-Transformer与知识自蒸馏提升香蕉品种跨等级分类泛化
items.title_en: Enhancing Cross-Grade Generalization in Banana Variety Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformers and Knowledge Self-Distillation
items.summary_zh: 在精准农业中，自动化水果分类已成为产量估计、质量控制和供应链优化的重要环节，但在品质差异、成熟度不同、光照变化、纹理退化、形态属性以及采后处理带来的域偏移下仍面临明显挑战。该研究聚焦真实场景中的跨等级香蕉品种分类问题，提出融合CNN与Transformer的混合架构，并结合知识自蒸馏，以提升模型在不同等级之间的泛化能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29008v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In recent years, automated fruit classification systems have become a more critical component in precision agriculture for efficient yield estimation, quality control, and supply chain optimization. However, they still face significant challenges under varying quality, fruit maturity, illumination, texture degradation, morphological attributes, domain shift, and post-harvest handling conditions. In this study, we address the challenging issue of cross-grade banana variety classification. This is a real-world setting where models that have been…
items.why_zh: 跨等级泛化是农业视觉模型落地时常见却被忽视的关键难点。
items.why_en: Cross-grade generalization is an overlooked but critical hurdle for deploying agricultural vision models.

items.title_zh: Huayu-Global：实时准全球降水反演系统
items.title_en: Huayu-Global: Skillful real-time quasi-global precipitation retrieval
items.summary_zh: 卫星降水产品长期面临两难：实时估计及时但精度较低，而最可靠的产品往往在观测数月后才发布，使高质量降水信息错过洪水预警与灾害响应的决策窗口。研究者提出Huayu-Global——一个跨星座深度学习系统，通过统一反演框架融合来自五颗卫星的三类静止轨道传感器数据流，生成时间一致的准全球降水场。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29213v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Satellite precipitation products face a persistent trade-off: real-time estimates are timely but less accurate, whereas the most reliable products are often released months after observation. This delay keeps high-quality precipitation information outside the decision window for flood warning and disaster response. Here we report Huayu-Global, a cross-constellation deep-learning system that combines three geostationary sensor streams from five satellites through a common retrieval framework and generates coherent quasi-global precipitation fiel…
items.why_zh: 把高质量降水估计拉进实时决策窗口，对洪水预警具有直接价值。
items.why_en: It brings high-quality precipitation estimates into real-time decision windows, directly benefiting flood warning.

items.title_zh: 大模型为何爱推荐AI？微调数据与流程或是源头
items.title_en: Where Do LLMs Learn to Recommend AI?
items.summary_zh: 当被问及该学什么、从事什么职业或做什么产品时，大语言模型常给出与AI相关的建议。研究者通过对比微调前后的模型并改变提问方式，追溯这一倾向的来源：预训练模型已有27%的回答明确包含AI/ML术语，公开的指令微调版本这一比例升至59%。但作者自行微调后发现，这种上升并非必然——通用指令微调并未带来相同的提升。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29785v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the…
items.why_zh: 表明模型的推荐偏好可能源于微调数据与流程，而非模型能力本身。
items.why_en: It suggests recommendation bias may stem from fine-tuning data and pipelines rather than capability itself.

items.title_zh: 每条告警皆有原因：可生成带精确根因的电信告警风暴开源工具
items.title_en: Every Alarm Has a Cause: An Open Generator of Telecom Alarm Storms with Exact Root Causes, Bound to NORIA-O, RFC 8632 and TMF642
items.summary_zh: 告警根因分析研究长期受制于数据不可共享：运营商日志属机密，公开的往往只是告警类型之间的因果图，而非逐条事件的真实根因，或仅有固定场景、需审批甚至从不发布。为此，作者不提供数据集，而是给出一个生成器：它在Internet Topology Zoo的真实骨干拓扑上运行，记录每条告警的确切根因与传播路径，并与NORIA-O、RFC 8632及TMF642标准对齐。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.30004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Alarm root-cause analysis is studied on data that cannot be shared. Operator logs are confidential, so what the field publishes is a causal graph between alarm types rather than per-incident causes, a fixed scenario set, gated, or never released. Two recent benchmarks carry per-incident root causes at scale; neither states a download location or a licence. We give a generator rather than a dataset. It runs on real backbone topologies from the Internet Topology Zoo and records the exact root cause and the propagation path of every alarm -- a by-…
items.why_zh: 以可生成的合成告警风暴绕开数据保密壁垒，为根因分析提供带精确标注的可复现数据。
items.why_en: A generator with exact labels sidesteps confidentiality barriers and enables reproducible root-cause research.

items.title_zh: CTBench：评估AI智能体在真实电信网络运维中的排障能力
items.title_en: CTBench: Evaluating Troubleshooting Capabilities of AI Agents in Realistic Telecom Network Operations
items.summary_zh: 自主智能体在网络运维中展现出潜力，但现有电信故障排查评测难以反映真实环境的部分可观测性与异构性。作者提出CTBench——一个由领域专家构建的公开基准，用于评估智能体在根因分析与路径恢复两类任务上的表现。该基准提供丰富的元数据与“黄金证据轨迹”，其指标同时考察最终结果的准确性与诊断推理过程。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12002v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While autonomous agents show promise for network operations, existing telecom troubleshooting evaluations fail to capture the partial observability and heterogeneity of real-world telecom environments. We introduce CTBench, a public benchmark evaluating agent troubleshooting capabilities in root cause analysis (RCA) and path restoration. Constructed by domain experts, CTBench features rich metadata and golden evidence trajectories, utilizing metrics that assess both final accuracy and diagnostic reasoning. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art a…
items.why_zh: 把评测从“是否答对”扩展到诊断推理过程，更贴近真实网络运维。
items.why_en: It evaluates diagnostic reasoning, not just final answers, better reflecting real network operations.

items.title_zh: StructLens：用最大生成树为语言模型提供结构视角
items.title_en: StructLens: A Structural Lens for Language Models via Maximum Spanning Trees
items.summary_zh: 语言本身具有结构，这既解释了语言习得，也解释了语言演变，因此语言模型内部也可能呈现自身的结构。以往可解释性研究多通过注意力模式和稀疏自编码器，从机制层面考察模型如何计算表征，却忽视了这些表征的组织方式。为填补这一空白，作者提出StructLens框架，借助最大生成树从整体结构视角分析模型表征。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.03328v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Language exhibits inherent structures, a property that explains both language acquisition and language change. Given this characteristic, we expect language models to manifest their own internal structures as well. While interpretability research has investigated how models compute representations mechanistically through attention patterns and Sparse AutoEncoders, the organization of the resulting representations is overlooked. To address this gap, we introduce StructLens, a framework to analyze representations through a holistic struct…
items.why_zh: 从“如何计算”转向“如何组织”，为模型可解释性补上结构视角。
items.why_en: It adds a structural perspective to interpretability, complementing mechanistic accounts of computation.

items.title_zh: 引用在偏好数据中的作用
items.title_en: On the Role of Citations in Preference Data
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究了“引用”在模型输出评价中的作用。作者指出，许多 NLP 任务要求系统给出归因，即标注输出所依据的来源，引用既能抑制模型幻觉，也方便用户核实输出可信度；但在比较两个输出优劣时，人类评审和大模型究竟如何看待引用，目前并不清楚，而这一过程正是奖励建模与现代 LLM 后训练的核心。研究在科学问答场景下，考察了人类评审与四个开源 LLM 在做偏好判断时对引用的重视程度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.21376v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many NLP tasks require systems to provide attribution in their outputs--i.e. citations to grounding sources. Attribution serves as a bulwark against model hallucination and as a means for users to verify the credibility of model outputs. Yet, it is unclear how humans and LLMs evaluate citations when comparing outputs, a process central to reward modeling and modern LLM post-training. This paper studies the role of citations in the preferences of human judges and four open-source LLMs within the context of scientific question answering,…
items.why_zh: 偏好数据是奖励建模与后训练的基石，厘清引用在其中的权重，有助于设计更可靠的归因与评测机制。
items.why_en: Preference data underpins reward modeling and post-training, so understanding how citations shape preferences matters for building reliable attribution and evaluation.

items.title_zh: 症状到疾病分类需要一个 9B 决策基座模型吗？Clef-Flash 微调与 TF-IDF 基线对比
items.title_en: Is a 9B Decision Foundation Model Needed for Symptom-to-Disease Classification? Fine-Tuning Clef-Flash Against TF-IDF Baselines
items.summary_zh: 论文关注如何根据患者自述症状描述做疾病分类。常见做法要么是轻量判别模型，要么是自回归大模型；后者语言理解广，但逐 token 生成文本、还需解析输出。作者转而研究“决策基座模型”：在一次前向传播中为封闭候选标签打分，无需生成文本。他们把基于 Qwen3.5 主干、拥有 90 亿参数的 Clef-Flash 适配到 24 类的 Symptom2Disease 基准上，并与 TF-IDF 类基线进行比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.15029v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using…
items.why_zh: 它检验了在症状分诊这类封闭标签任务上，大参数决策模型是否真的优于廉价基线，为实际部署选型提供依据。
items.why_en: It tests whether a large decision foundation model actually beats cheap baselines on closed-label tasks like symptom triage, informing deployment choices.

items.title_zh: 大声明、小差距：GraphLLM 报告的提升能否经受简单基线检验？
items.title_en: Big Claims, Small Margins: Do Reported GraphLLM Gains Survive Simple Baselines?
items.summary_zh: 基于 LLM 的文本属性图（TAG）节点分类方法常宣称达到 SOTA。作者在近期三项研究使用的相同数据划分上，用仅依赖验证集的方式调优四个代表性基线，再与各论文在匹配设置下报告的 LLM 方法最高平均成绩对比。结果显示：在 TF-IDF 特征上运行 Correct & Smooth，中位数仅落后该参照 2.3 个百分点；在冻结的 e5-large-v2 特征上训练 MLP 也表现接近。这提示 GraphLLM 的领先幅度可能被高估。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based methods for node classification on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) routinely report state-of-the-art accuracy. We ask how these results compare with inexpensive baselines run on the same splits. On the splits of three recent studies, we tune four baseline representatives with validation-only selection and compare them with the highest mean that each paper reports for an LLM-based method in the matched setting. Correct & Smooth on TF-IDF features trails this reference by a median of 2.3 percentage points, and an MLP on frozen e5-large-v2 e…
items.why_zh: 它提醒社区：缺乏强基线的对比容易夸大 LLM 在图学习上的进展，评测规范亟需收紧。
items.why_en: It cautions that missing strong baselines can inflate reported LLM gains on graphs, highlighting the need for stricter evaluation practices.

items.title_zh: 用知识重铸对抗持续域适应中的灾难性遗忘
items.title_en: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
items.summary_zh: 把语言模型后训练到新领域，可能损害其原有能力，即灾难性遗忘。现有缓解方法多把遗忘视为模型漂移过度的结果，因而通过保留旧输出、回放旧数据或正则化参数与表示来约束更新，使新模型尽量接近旧状态。作者提出不同视角：不是把模型拉回旧状态，而是通过“知识重铸”的思路重新组织已有能力。论文在持续域适应场景下验证该方法对遗忘的抑制效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old stat…
items.why_zh: 为模型持续适配新领域时保留旧能力提供了不同于“约束漂移”的新思路。
items.why_en: It offers a new angle beyond drift-constraining for retaining old capabilities while adapting models to new domains.

items.title_zh: FlashNext-RL：面向 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 长程智能体强化学习的系统优化
items.title_en: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
items.summary_zh: 长程智能体强化学习既需要高效的 rollout 生成，又要在长序列上训练，但 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的内存需求和专属算子让现有开源实现难以胜任。为此作者提出 FlashNext-RL：一个基于 prime-rl 的模型定制化 RL 训练优化框架，并用 vLLM 负责软件工程（SWE）任务的 rollout 生成。工作重点是单台 8xB200 节点上对完整 48 层模型进行 BF16 训练。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the…
items.why_zh: 它给出在有限硬件上训练大型智能体 RL 的可行工程路径，对智能体训练落地具有参考价值。
items.why_en: It shows a practical engineering path for running large agentic RL training on limited hardware.

items.title_zh: 隐藏学习结构的动力学
items.title_en: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
items.summary_zh: 学习器当前的预测并不能完全决定它接下来会如何学习。论文通过两个相互关联的操作来研究“隐藏学习结构”的动力学。其一是纤维调节理论（FRT），描述对既有功能的受保护修复，以及修复后仍可用的学习响应；其二是纤维获取理论（FAT），描述可训练结构的形成与更新，区分中性安装、获得学习信号以及新增功能方向。两种操作彼此约束：例如一次修复会影响后续可获取的结构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29054v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair oblig…
items.why_zh: 它试图从理论上刻画“预测之外”的学习动力学，为理解模型如何继续学习提供新框架。
items.why_en: It offers a theoretical framework for learning dynamics that go beyond current predictions.

items.title_zh: 刻画无感知共同奖励多玩家老虎机：普适平稳性、协调陷阱与可证全局速率
items.title_en: Characterizing Oblivious Common-Reward Multi-Player Bandits: Universal Stationarity, Coordination Traps, and Certified Global Rates
items.summary_zh: 论文对“无感知共同奖励多玩家多臂老虎机”（OC-MPMAB）进行理论分析。这是极简的多玩家老虎机模型：多个玩家同时选择臂，但只能观测到一个共享奖励；关键在于玩家完全无感知——看不到他人的动作，甚至不知道是否存在其他玩家。作者给出三方面贡献，其中包括证明各玩家独立执行的梯度老虎机更新会共同构成一个无偏的随机过程，并讨论了协调陷阱与可证的全局收敛速率。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29673v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the oblivious common-reward multi-player multi-armed bandit (OC-MPMAB), a minimal multi-player bandit model in which multiple players select arms simultaneously and observe only a shared reward. Crucially, the players are fully oblivious: they do not observe the actions of other players and do not even know whether any other players exist. The contributions of this work are threefold. First, we prove that the independent gradient-bandit updates applied by the players jointly form an unbiased stochasti…
items.why_zh: 为去中心化多智能体学习中的协调与收敛问题提供了严格的理论刻画。
items.why_en: It provides rigorous theory on coordination and convergence in decentralized multi-agent learning.

items.title_zh: FrontierCS 2：面向计算机科学研发的基准
items.title_en: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 FrontierCS 2，用于检验 LLM 智能体能否对前沿计算机科学研究与开发做出贡献。该基准包含 48 个开放式任务：取一篇论文及其作者公开的代码，删去论文的核心贡献，被删掉的代码即成为人类参考标准。与以往只给问题描述、跑完后评一个程序的开放式基准不同，FrontierCS 2 把智能体置于研究环境中：它继承一个可运行的代码仓库，可在任意时刻提交补丁，每个补丁由评审给出反馈。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge retur…
items.why_zh: 它把评测从“写一个程序”推进到“在真实研究环境中迭代改进”，更贴近前沿科研的实际形态。
items.why_en: It moves evaluation from one-shot program writing to iterative work inside a real research environment, closer to actual frontier R&D.

items.title_zh: 理解限价订单簿状态空间基础模型的内部机制
items.title_en: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注用于限价订单簿（LOB）的自回归基础模型：这类模型能通过生成订单消息流来模拟市场，但其内部机制尚不清楚，既难以聚焦研究方向，也影响其在真实交易环境中的落地。作者因此追问模型究竟学到了哪些市场微观结构，并以一个约820万参数的 Mamba-3 状态空间模型为对象展开分析。研究发现，与序列模型在棋类游戏中构建内部“棋盘”表示类似，该模型也会形成对市场的内部表征。论文进一步讨论这些表示对理解模型行为及实际应用的意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.28753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trai…
items.why_zh: 理解金融市场基础模型的内部表示，是评估其可靠性并推动实盘应用的关键。
items.why_en: Understanding what market-generating foundation models learn internally is key to assessing their reliability and enabling real-world trading use.

items.title_zh: pplx-embed-v2-late 技术报告：0.6B 与 9B 多语言多模态嵌入模型
items.title_en: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
items.summary_zh: 该技术报告发布 pplx-embed-v2-late，包括 0.6B 与 9B 两个多语言、多模态的晚交互（late-interaction）嵌入模型。两者在各自参数规模档的文本、图像和视觉文档检索基准上均取得领先结果；其中 0.6B 版本在视觉文档检索任务上可与数倍于自身规模的模型竞争。模型通过从 18B 教师模型进行表示蒸馏训练，因而共享同一嵌入空间，支持非对称部署。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.29523v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deplo…
items.why_zh: 更小却更强的多模态检索嵌入模型可降低部署成本，并支持大小模型协同的非对称检索架构。
items.why_en: Stronger yet smaller multimodal retrieval embeddings can lower deployment costs and enable asymmetric retrieval with shared embedding spaces.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型量化技术的全面评估
items.title_en: A Comprehensive Evaluation on Quantization Techniques for Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 该综述聚焦大语言模型（LLM）的训练后量化（PTQ），这一技术可显著降低内存与计算开销。作者指出，现有研究往往缺乏在同一实验条件下的对比，且量化方案通常由多个组件构成，需要厘清各种方法之间的联系。为此，论文对当前最先进方法进行了最新且广泛的梳理，并开展全面评估，以弥补上述空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.17417v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: For large language models (LLMs), post-training quantization (PTQ) significantly reduces memory and computational overhead. Despite rapid advancements, existing papers often lack experiments on the same ground. In addition, since quantization solutions typically contain multiple components, it is important to analyze the connections among numerous existing methods to gain an in-depth understanding of this field. To bridge these gaps, we conduct an up-to-date and extensive review of the state-of-the-art methods and perform comprehensive evalua…
items.why_zh: 量化是 LLM 落地的关键降本手段，统一基准与系统评估有助于研究者和工程师选择可靠方案。
items.why_en: Quantization is a key cost-reduction lever for LLM deployment; unified benchmarks and systematic evaluation help practitioners choose reliable methods.

items.title_zh: 经验去噪器的隐私核算
items.title_en: Privacy Accounting for Empirical Denoisers
items.summary_zh: 扩散模型是现代生成系统的基础，但其强大的记忆能力带来隐私风险。差分隐私（DP）训练可提供形式化保证，却会牺牲样本质量。本文研究一个互补问题：采样过程本身会带来多少隐私损失。由于现代神经去噪器对单个训练样本的敏感度通常难以直接分析，作者通过构造可分析的去噪器来克服这一难题，并给出面向经验去噪器的隐私核算方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.27710v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as the foundation of modern generative systems, yet their high memorization capacity raises privacy concerns. While differentially private (DP) training provides formal guarantees, it comes at a cost in sample quality. In this work, we study a complementary question: how much privacy loss is incurred during the sampling process itself? Directly analyzing modern neural denoisers is challenging because their sensitivity to a single training example is generally intractable. To overcome this challenge, we construct…
items.why_zh: 将隐私风险从训练扩展到采样阶段，有助于更完整地评估生成式模型的实际泄露风险。
items.why_en: Extending privacy risk analysis from training to sampling gives a more complete picture of real-world leakage in generative models.

items.title_zh: 利用凹性信息的高斯过程上下文赌博机优化
items.title_en: Exploiting Concavity Information in Gaussian Process Contextual Bandit Optimization
items.summary_zh: 上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）用于建模奖励同时取决于所选动作和观测上下文的序贯决策问题。在医学、商业和工程等领域，先验知识常提供奖励函数的结构信息，可用于提升优化效率。本文研究在每个可观测上下文下，条件平均奖励关于动作变量已知为凹函数的情形，并据此开发上下文赌博机算法，以利用凹性结构加速优化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2503.10836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The contextual bandit models sequential decision-making problems in which rewards depend on both the chosen action and observed context. In many domains such as medicine, business, and engineering, prior knowledge provides structural information about the reward function that can be exploited to improve optimization efficiency. This paper studies settings where, for each observable context, the conditional mean reward is known to be concave with respect to the action variable. To leverage this structure, we develop a contextual bandit a…
items.why_zh: 把已知的凹性结构注入上下文赌博机，有望在有限试验次数下提升医疗、商业等决策优化的效率。
items.why_en: Injecting known concavity into contextual bandits can improve decision optimization efficiency in domains such as medicine and business under limited trials.

items.title_zh: GLUScope：分析 Transformer 语言模型中 GLU 神经元的工具
items.title_en: GLUScope: A Tool for Analyzing GLU Neurons in Transformer Language Models
items.summary_zh: 研究团队发布开源工具 GLUScope，面向可解释性研究者，用于分析 Transformer 语言模型中的神经元。工具聚焦近年几乎成为标准配置的 GLU 类激活函数（如 SwiGLU）。这类结构带来新挑战：仅理解正激活并不够，因为神经元的 gate 与 in 激活均可正可负，形成四种符号组合（激活象限），需要专门工具加以区分和分析。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.23826v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present **GLUScope**, an open-source resource for analyzing neurons in Transformer-based language models (LMs), intended for interpretability researchers. We focus on the now-standard *GLU-based activation functions* such as SwiGLU, used in virtually all recent open-weights LMs. This introduces a new challenge: understanding positive activations is not enough. Instead, both the *gate* and the *in* activation of a neuron can be positive or negative, leading to four different possible sign combinations (*activation quadrants*) that in…
items.why_zh: GLU 神经元符号组合复杂，专门工具能帮助可解释性研究更准确地定位和分析语言模型内部单元。
items.why_en: GLU neurons have complex sign combinations; dedicated tooling helps interpretability researchers more accurately locate and analyze internal language-model units.

items.title_zh: 用于观看时长分布预测的分层指数-高斯混合模型
items.title_en: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
items.summary_zh: 短视频推荐需要准确预测观看时长（WT），但 WT 分布具有近零膨胀、长尾和多峰特征。此前的指数-高斯混合网络（EGMN）建模完整条件分布而非单点估计，并取得领先性能。本文的大规模复现发现 EGMN 易出现方差坍缩、组件冗余和组件不活跃等问题，因此提出分层指数-高斯混合模型（HEGM）以改进预测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.23356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurate watch-time (WT) prediction is an important requirement for short-video recommendations. Yet WT distributions are near-zero-inflated, long-tailed and multimodal. The recent Exponential-Gaussian Mixture Network (EGMN) models the full conditional WT distribution rather than a single point estimate and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our large-scale reproduction study reveals that EGMN is vulnerable to variance collapse, component redundancy, and inactive components. We propose a Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixture (HE…
items.why_zh: 观看时长分布建模直接影响短视频推荐效果，修正混合模型的训练缺陷具有明确的产品价值。
items.why_en: Modeling watch-time distributions directly affects short-video recommendation quality, so fixing mixture-model training flaws has clear product value.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek据悉完成1000亿元融资，宁德时代和腾讯参投-36氪
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Completes RMB 100 Billion Funding Round with CATL and Tencent
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek据悉完成1000亿元融资，宁德时代和腾讯参投-36氪 36kr

The report did not disclose valuation, use of proceeds, or deal terms, and the parties have not publicly confirmed the round. items.why_en: If confirmed, the huge round and backing from industrial giants would strengthen DeepSeek's compute and ecosystem position and reshape China's LLM competitive landscape.

items.why_zh: 若融资落地，DeepSeek 的估值与现金储备将显著抬升，直接影响其与 OpenAI、Anthropic 等对手的长期竞争格局。
items.why_en: If completed, the round would sharply boost DeepSeek's valuation and war chest, reshaping its long-term race with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title_zh: 宇树科技王兴兴：目前物理 AI 已经看到被击穿的苗头
items.title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing: Physical AI Shows Signs of Breaking Through, Embodied AI's ChatGPT Moment Nears

items.summary_en: At the 2026 World Physical AI Conference in Hangzhou, Unitree founder Wang Xingxing said physical AI is showing signs of a breakthrough following the release of GPT-6, and that embodied AI could hit its 'ChatGPT moment' within one to three years. The key bottleneck, he said, is aligning model inputs and outputs with real robots, with commercial services likely to adopt faster than homes or factories.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，MiniMax 的股价已经回吐自今年 1 月上市以来的全部涨幅。激烈的行业竞争，迫使投资者重新评估这家大模型企业。 IT之家注意到，该股今日在港股盘中最大跌幅达 7.3%，跌至 159.3 港元，跌破其 IPO 发行价 165 港元。 MiniMax 于 2026 年 1 月 9 日以 165 港元的定价上限登陆港交所，全球发售约 3358 万股，募集资金总额约 55.4 亿港元，公司成立仅四年即完成上市，刷新 AI 企业最快上市纪录。上市首日其股价大涨 109% 至 345 港元，3 月受应用概念催化一度冲高至 1330 港元，较发行价涨超 7 倍。 但随后市场情绪转冷，下跌原因来自行业竞争、商业化难题以及高昂成本。国内竞争对手 DeepSeek 持续推出低价模型，海外对手 OpenAI、Anthropic 也大幅降价。 据彭博社报道，10 月 19 日 MiniMax 发布的新模型市场反响平平，进一步加剧了本轮抛售。而在今年 6 月，该公司旗舰模型 M3 直接降价一半，当时股价就已经出现大幅下挫。 基本面上，公司仍处亏损阶段。财报显示，MiniMax 2026 年上半年总收入 1.17 亿美元，同比增长 283.1%，但经调整净亏损 2.93 亿美元，同比扩大 111.2%。
items.summary_en: MiniMax's Hong Kong-listed shares fell below their HK$165 IPO price, dropping as much as 7.3% intraday to HK$159.3 and erasing all gains since listing. The stock had surged 109% on its debut and peaked at HK$1,330 in March, more than seven times the IPO price. The reversal reflects intensifying competition, commercialization challenges and high costs, with DeepSeek, OpenAI and Anthropic cutting prices and MiniMax's new model receiving a muted market response.

items.summary_zh: 彭博：DeepSeek完成由宁德时代和腾讯领投的150亿美元融资 提供者 Investing.com 英为财情 Investing.com
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that DeepSeek has completed a $15 billion funding round led by CATL and Tencent, equivalent to about 100 billion yuan and one of China's largest private financings in recent years. The capital is expected to support global expansion and competition with OpenAI and Anthropic, and could pave the way for an IPO. DeepSeek has not publicly confirmed the details.
items.why_zh: 150亿美元融资凸显 DeepSeek 的全球扩张野心，也可能重塑中美 AI 竞争的资金格局。
items.why_en: The $15 billion round highlights DeepSeek's global ambitions and could reshape the funding balance in U.S.-China AI competition.

items.title_zh: 微软 CEO 纳德拉 2026 财年总薪酬 9060 万美元，较去年下调 6.11%
items.title_en: Microsoft CEO Nadella's FY2026 Pay Falls 6.11% to $90.6 Million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，据 The Information 今日报道，微软董事会在 2026 年 10 月向股东提交的代理委托书（Proxy Filing）中，为 CEO 萨提亚 · 纳德拉（Satya Nadella）申请的 2026 财年（2025 年 7 月 1 日～2026 年 6 月 30 日）总薪酬包为 9,060 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.06 亿元人民币）。 这一数字略低于 2025 财年的 9,650 万美元 （现汇率约合 6.46 亿元人民币） ， 下调了 6.11% 。 报道称，尽管微软的云计算（Azure 个人年营收突破 1,000 亿美元）及大部分 AI 业务均达到或超过了董事会的预期目标， 但由于 Xbox 游戏业务的营收下滑 ，拖累了纳德拉的绩效奖金指标。 纳德拉的基本工资依然维持在每年 250 万美元 （现汇率约合 1,672.3 万元人民币） ， 其余 95% 以上的收入依然由与公司长期表现挂钩的 股票期权与绩效奖金 组成 。 图源：Pexels
items.summary_en: Microsoft disclosed in a proxy filing that CEO Satya Nadella's fiscal 2026 compensation package is $90.6 million, down 6.11% from $96.5 million a year earlier. His base salary remains $2.5 million, with more than 95% of pay tied to long-term stock and performance awards. Despite Azure surpassing $100 billion in annual revenue and most AI businesses meeting or beating board targets, declining Xbox gaming revenue weighed on his bonus.
items.why_zh: 薪酬下调反映 Xbox 业务拖累，也显示 AI 与云业务表现已成为科技巨头高管激励的核心变量。
items.why_en: The pay cut reflects Xbox weakness and shows that AI and cloud performance have become central to executive incentives at tech giants.

items.title_zh: 王兴兴：宇树 G1 已累计生产下线约 1-2 万台，是全球最畅销的人形机器人
items.title_en: Wang Xingxing: Unitree G1 Hits 10,000–20,000 Units Produced, World's Best-Selling Humanoid Robot
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，据《科创板日报》报道，在 2026 世界物理 AI 大会暨宇树合作伙伴生态大会上，宇树科技创始人王兴兴表示，自 2024 年 5 月发布以来，宇树 G1 机器人已经累计生产下线约 1-2 万台，是全球最畅销的人形机器人。 延伸阅读 公开资料显示，本次大会主题为“宇十俱进，树业共生”，包括 3000 余名嘉宾、4000 余平方米主论坛区域以及 40 余个展示专区。 在大会消息公布后的 2026 年 10 月 19 日，宇树科技股价盘中涨超 17%，一度超过 500 元 / 股，截至当日收盘总市值重回 2000 亿元，报 495.92 元 / 股。 公开信息显示，王兴兴为宇树科技创始人，现任公司董事长、总经理兼首席技术官。 2026 年 8 月 19 日，宇树科技正式在科创板 IPO 上市。 IT之家注意到，宇树 G1 人形机器人于 2024 年 5 月 13 日正式发布，官方描述为“人形智能体、AI 化身”，定价 9.9 万元起，分为基础配置的 G1 和配置可选的 G1 EDU 版本。 该机器人体重约 35kg、身高约 127cm，拥有 23~43 个关节电机，关节最大扭矩 120N·m，支持模仿与强化学习驱动，搭载 UnifoLM（Unitree 机器人统一大模型），配有 3D 激光雷达与深度相机，续航约 2 小时。
items.summary_en: Unitree founder Wang Xingxing said the company has produced roughly 10,000–20,000 G1 humanoid robots since its May 2024 launch, calling it the world's best-selling humanoid. The 9.9万元-plus G1 weighs about 35kg, stands 127cm tall and runs the UnifoLM model; the news helped push Unitree's shares up as much as 17% intraday after its August 2026 STAR Market IPO.
items.why_zh: 这一数字为人形机器人是否真正走向规模化量产与商业落地提供了罕见的销量参照。
items.why_en: The figure offers a rare volume benchmark for whether humanoid robots are truly reaching mass production and commercial adoption.

items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Closes Nearly 100 Billion Yuan Round Led by CATL, Tencent
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek完成近1000亿元融资，宁德时代、腾讯领衔，至少两次上调融资目标 风闻
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has reportedly closed a funding round of roughly 100 billion yuan, led by battery maker CATL and Tencent, after raising its target at least twice. Valuation, investor terms and use of proceeds were not disclosed, and the report has not been officially confirmed.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这将是国内大模型行业最大规模融资之一，凸显产业资本对基础模型的密集押注。
items.why_en: If confirmed, it would be one of China's largest foundation-model financings, showing industrial capital's aggressive bet on AI.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元融资：腾讯、宁德时代投资

items.summary_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元融资：腾讯、宁德时代投资 凤凰网
items.summary_en: Phoenix News reports DeepSeek raised about 100 billion yuan with Tencent and CATL among the investors, corroborating earlier reports of a near-100-billion-yuan round. Terms such as valuation and individual stakes were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 多家媒体交叉报道同一巨额融资，进一步强化了市场对 DeepSeek 资金实力与算力扩张的预期。
items.why_en: Multiple outlets reporting the same huge round strengthens expectations about DeepSeek's resources and compute expansion.

items.summary_zh: 消息称DeepSeek已融资1000亿元：两次上调目标 腾讯、宁德时代投资 凤凰网
items.summary_en: Phoenix News, citing sources, reports DeepSeek closed about 100 billion yuan in funding after raising its target twice, with Tencent and CATL investing. Valuation, ownership stakes and use of proceeds were not disclosed, and the company has not confirmed the round.
items.why_zh: “两次上调目标”反映投资方认购热情，若属实将是国产大模型融资热度的重要信号。
items.why_en: The twice-raised target signals strong investor demand and, if accurate, a notable marker of enthusiasm for Chinese LLM developers.

items.summary_en: TradingView reported that DeepSeek has completed a financing round of about RMB 100 billion, led by CATL and Tencent. The report did not specify the round, valuation or use of proceeds, and no official confirmation has been made. If confirmed, it would be one of the largest fundraisings by a Chinese AI model company.
items.why_zh: 约1000亿元融资若落地，将为DeepSeek的模型研发与全球竞争提供强大资金支持。
items.why_en: If the roughly RMB 100 billion round materializes, it would give DeepSeek substantial funding for model R&D and global competition.

items.title_zh: 迈步“史上最大 IPO”，消息称 Anthropic 最快本周五公开提交上市申请
items.title_en: Anthropic May File Public IPO Paperwork as Soon as Friday, Potentially the Largest Ever
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，当地时间 21 日，据雅虎财经援引三名知情人士消息称，Anthropic 最早或于本周五公开提交 S-1 招股说明书，为有望创下史上最大规模的 IPO 迈出关键一步。 Anthropic 的上市计划备受关注，预计规模将超过 SpaceX 今年 6 月的 IPO 。随着投资者对 AI 行业巨额支出的担忧加剧，市场普遍认为，Anthropic 上市将成为检验投资者对 AI 热潮还有多大兴趣的一次重要考验。 今年 6 月，Anthropic 向美国证券交易委员会秘密提交了 IPO 申请草案。根据规定，采用保密申报程序的企业，须在正式投资者路演开始至少 15 个自然日前公开申请文件。 如果顺利公开招股书，Anthropic 距离 11 月上市 就将更近一步，但最终发行时间仍受市场环境等因素影响。届时，普通投资者也将首次得以了解其具体财务数据及潜在风险。 Anthropic 斥资数十亿美元建设 AI 基础设施，以支持 Claude 系列模型的训练和运行。除了与谷歌、亚马逊合作，公司还租用 SpaceX 旗下 Colossus 1 数据中心的 GPU 算力。 今年上半年，Anthropic 营收达到 163 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,090.36 亿元人民币） ，净亏损超过 800 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,351.46 亿元人民币） 。华尔街预计…
items.summary_en: Anthropic could publicly file its S-1 as soon as Friday, moving toward a listing expected to exceed SpaceX's June IPO in size after confidentially filing in June. The filing would give ordinary investors their first look at its finances; first-half revenue hit $16.3 billion against a net loss of more than $80 billion, per the report.
items.why_zh: 这场超大规模 IPO 将成为衡量资本市场对 AI 高投入模式容忍度的关键风向标。
items.why_en: The mega-IPO will be a key gauge of how much investors will still tolerate AI's enormous spending.

items.title_zh: 外媒：DeepSeek 融资 150 亿美元，挑战美国顶级 AI 实验室
items.title_en: China’s DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion to Challenge Top US AI Labs
items.summary_zh: 彭博社报道称，中国 AI 公司 DeepSeek 完成约 150 亿美元融资，意在挑战美国顶级 AI 实验室。按当前汇率粗略换算，这一规模与中文媒体所称“近 1000 亿元人民币”大体相当，可视为同一轮融资的英文口径报道。报道将这笔资金置于中美 AI 竞争背景下解读，认为其将增强 DeepSeek 与 OpenAI、Anthropic 等美国公司竞争的能力。目前公司未公布估值、具体投资方名单与资金用途等细节，相关数字仍待官方确认。
items.summary_en: China’s DeepSeek Raises $15 Billion to Challenge Top US AI Labs Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 西方主流财经媒体的英文口径报道，把中国大模型公司放到了与 OpenAI 等直接竞争的叙事框架中。
items.why_en: Coverage by a major Western financial outlet frames a Chinese model maker as a direct rival to OpenAI and peers.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek开源推理框架，有人算出AI的毛利：82%
items.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources Inference Framework; One Analysis Puts AI Gross Margin at 82%
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek开源推理框架，有人算出AI的毛利：82% 搜狐
items.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sourced its inference framework, prompting an outside analysis that estimates roughly 82% gross margin for its AI services by comparing throughput and hardware efficiency against public pricing. The figure is a third-party estimate based on assumptions, not official financials.
items.why_zh: 把推理效率转化为可计算的毛利数字，为讨论大模型商业模式能否盈利提供了具体参照。
items.why_en: Turning inference efficiency into a concrete margin number gives a tangible reference for whether LLM businesses can be profitable.

items.title_zh: 路透社：特斯拉 AI 转型承压，2026 全年支出目标降幅约 20%
items.title_en: Reuters: Tesla Cuts 2026 Capex Target by About 20% as AI Shift Faces Pressure
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，路透社昨日（10 月 21 日）发布博文，报道称基于特斯拉第 3 季度财报数据，公司资本支出为 47.3 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 316.41 亿元人民币） ，虽较去年同期增长逾一倍，却远低于市场预期的约 77 亿至 79.5 亿美元 （现汇率约合 515.08 亿至 531.8 亿元人民币） 。 财报数据显示，特斯拉第三季度资本支出为 47.3 亿美元 （现汇率约合 316.41 亿元人民币） ，较去年同期翻倍以上，但较第二季度减少约 10 亿美元 （现汇率约合 66.89 亿元人民币） ，也明显低于彭博汇编的分析师平均预期 79.5 亿美元 （现汇率约合 531.8 亿元人民币） 。 特斯拉同时下调 2026 年全年资本支出目标， 从逾 250 亿美元 下调至约 200 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,337.87 亿元人民币） ，降幅约为 20%。尽管支出放缓，特斯拉第三季度仍实现约 15.3 亿美元 （现汇率约合 102.35 亿元人民币） 自由现金流，明显好于市场原本预期的负值。 路透社认为特斯拉已释放“少花钱”的信号，虽然能改善短期现金流，但也让外界担忧特斯拉的转型投入节奏。马斯克此前希望特斯拉不再只是一家电动车制造商，转向人工智能、自动驾驶、人形机器人 Optimus 和芯片制造等更高增长、更高投入的领域。相关投资包括 Optim…
items.summary_en: Reuters, citing Tesla's Q3 results, notes capex of $4.73 billion came in far below the roughly $7.7–7.95 billion expected, and Tesla cut its 2026 capex target from over $25 billion to about $20 billion. Free cash flow of about $1.53 billion beat expectations, but the slower spending raises questions about Musk's AI, robotaxi and Optimus ambitions.
items.why_zh: 资本支出不及预期，直接关系特斯拉能否兑现其 AI 与机器人转型的长期承诺。
items.why_en: Capex falling short of expectations directly bears on whether Tesla can deliver its long-term AI and robotics promises.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉：预计明年二季度让车主车辆接入自动驾驶出租车车队
items.title_en: Tesla Expects Owner Cars to Join Robotaxi Fleet in Q2 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，多年来，埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）一直向特斯拉车主许下宏大承诺，包括推出无监督 FSD 功能，以及允许车主将自家车辆接入公司的自动驾驶出租车车队。在今日的第三季度财报电话会议上，特斯拉终于给出了一个明确时间。 特斯拉自动驾驶副总裁阿肖克 · 埃卢斯瓦米（Ashok Elluswamy）表示，特斯拉车主将能在 2027 年第二季度把自己的车辆接入公司自动驾驶出租车车队。以下是他的原话： 就像我前面提到的，Cybercab 和 Model Y 使用的是同一套软件。很快我们就会在 V15 版本更新中将这套软件推送给用户。唯一额外的要求是，例如要确保用户的 Model Y 能够纳入特斯拉的地理围栏与车队管理体系，从而实现完全自动驾驶。我们预计大约在明年第二季度，可以让首批用户车辆接入自动驾驶出租车车队。 这个时间节点值得留意，因为特斯拉很有可能再次延期。在自动驾驶与自动驾驶出租车这件事上，马斯克已经形成十分明显的模式：定下激进的短期目标，最后延期数年，甚至计划彻底落空。尽管如此，特斯拉在面向普通消费者的驾驶辅助技术上，确实取得了持续小幅的进步。但长期承诺的“无监督”FSD 功能至今仍未落地。 2019 年，马斯克在公司首届人工智能日的舞台上承诺，车主的私家车可以加入名为“特斯拉网络”的自动驾驶出租车车队，车辆在自主接单运营时，车主就能获得被动收…
items.summary_en: Tesla's Autopilot VP Ashok Elluswamy said owners should be able to add their cars to the company's robotaxi fleet around Q2 2027, since Cybercab and Model Y share the same software, to be pushed via V15, with the extra requirement of geofencing and fleet management integration. Musk has a long record of missing such deadlines.
items.why_zh: 这是特斯拉首次为“车主车辆加入 Robotaxi 车队”给出具体时间，但此前多次跳票使可信度仍待验证。
items.why_en: It is Tesla's first concrete date for letting owner cars join its robotaxi fleet, though a history of delays keeps skepticism high.

items.title_zh: 稀缺不是护城河，智谱跌去万亿市值的深刻启示
items.title_en: Scarcity Is Not a Moat: Lessons From Zhipu’s Trillion-Yuan Market Value Drop
items.summary_zh: 稀缺不是护城河，智谱跌去万亿市值的深刻启示 新浪财经
items.summary_en: A commentary carried by Sina Finance uses Zhipu’s massive market value decline to argue that scarcity is not a moat. It says AI companies cannot rely on scarcity labels or first-mover advantages to justify high valuations, and must build sustainable advantages through technology iteration, product deployment, and commercialization. The case serves as a warning about valuation logic and fundamentals for Zhipu and the broader large-model sector.
items.why_zh: 它提醒AI行业，稀缺性叙事不能替代真实商业壁垒，估值终将回归基本面。
items.why_en: It cautions the AI industry that scarcity narratives cannot replace real business moats, and valuations ultimately return to fundamentals.

items.title_zh: Hey OnStar 登场：通用汽车推出 OnStar AI，能看懂车辆、听懂车主表述
items.title_en: GM Launches OnStar AI Assistant That Understands Vehicles and Driver Requests
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，通用汽车（GM）昨日（10 月 21 日）发布博文， 宣布升级 OnStar（国内称安吉星），打造成为面向智能驾驶时代的“互联智能平台”，并推出全新的 OnStar AI 助手。 这一原生 AI 助手将率先通过 OTA 升级搭载于 2027 款凯迪拉克 Lyriq，随后逐步扩展至更多通用品牌车型。 与过去主要承担紧急救援、道路救援和人工客服的呼叫中心不同，新版 OnStar 将转型为“联网智能平台”。用户可通过“Hey OnStar”语音唤醒助手，询问车辆警报含义、检查发动机提示、电动车续航是否足够抵达下一充电站等问题；AI 还能结合实时车辆数据、用户授权的上下文信息和通用汽车的车辆知识库，提供更个性化的建议。 IT之家附上相关介绍视频如下： 在具体功能上，该助手可解释车辆警告和异常提示音，支持通过语音控制空调等部分车载功能，并计划结合天气、路况、路线信息及用户数字日历，主动提供出行建议。 当问题需要人工介入后，系统仍可转接 OnStar 顾问；通用汽车强调，涉及气囊触发等紧急情况时，人工客服仍将负责联系救援机构。 通用汽车还计划于 2027 年推出统一的 OnStar 手机应用，与车载软件深度同步，并取代现有 OnStar Guardian 及别克、凯迪拉克、雪佛兰、GMC 等品牌独立应用。 OnStar 目前在 22 个市场拥有超过 1,200…
items.summary_en: GM is upgrading OnStar into a connected intelligent platform and launching an OnStar AI assistant. Drivers can wake it with “Hey OnStar” to interpret vehicle alerts, check engine warnings, and assess EV range, with personalized advice based on vehicle data and authorized context. It will debut via OTA on the 2027 Cadillac Lyriq and later expand to more GM brands, while human advisors remain responsible for emergencies.
items.why_zh: 传统车载服务正被AI重构，座舱与车主服务可能成为车企差异化竞争的新入口。
items.why_en: Traditional in-car services are being reshaped by AI, making the cockpit and owner services a potential new front for automaker differentiation.

items.title_zh: 影响约 70% 网站：PHP 高危漏洞被修复，OpenAI 牵头协调全球发现 / 修复
items.title_en: OpenAI-led effort fixes high-risk PHP flaws affecting about 70% of websites
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，OpenAI 公司昨日（10 月 21 日）发布博文，宣布通过其“修补地球”（Patch the Planet）计划，协助安全研究人员发现了 PHP 编程语言中的两项严重漏洞， 并联合 PHP 维护团队、安全公司、云服务商及多国网络安全机构，在漏洞公开前完成了为期约两个月的协调修复。 安全公司 Calif 借助 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 模型发现其中一项关键缺陷；谷歌旗下的 Wiz 则独立发现并报告了相关漏洞。PHP 官方维护者主导了漏洞验证、修复开发与版本发布，OpenAI、Wiz、Cloudflare 等则提供研究、技术支持和跨机构协调，以便在公开披露前完成防护准备。 OpenAI 称，这是前沿 AI 在攻击者之前发现高危漏洞的案例，为维护者和防御方争取到所谓“防御者之窗”。不过，公司也承认，同样的 AI 能力可能被攻击者用于更快开发攻击工具和漏洞利用程序，安全风险与防御价值并存。 IT之家此前报道，本次曝光的两项漏洞被统称为“PHP2Shell”， 编号分别为 CVE-2026-109618 和 CVE-2026-109619 ，CVSS v4.0 评分均为 9.2。 PHP 是支撑全球大量网站和 Web 应用的开源脚本语言，业界估计约 70% 的网站依赖其运行。 此次漏洞可能允许未经身份验证的攻击者远程执行代码，进而篡改网站…
items.summary_en: OpenAI said its Patch the Planet initiative helped uncover two severe PHP vulnerabilities and coordinated a roughly two-month fix with PHP maintainers, security firms, cloud providers and national cyber agencies. The flaws, tracked as PHP2Shell with CVSS 9.2 ratings, could allow unauthenticated remote code execution and affect the roughly 70% of websites powered by PHP. OpenAI called it a “defender’s window” while warning the same AI capabilities could be misused by attackers.
items.why_zh: 前沿 AI 首次在漏洞公开前协助发现并协调修复影响面极大的基础软件缺陷，同时凸显 AI 双用途风险。
items.why_en: It shows frontier AI helping find and coordinate fixes for critical open-source flaws before disclosure, while highlighting dual-use risks.

items.title_zh: 沃尔玛推出自有智能体网关，AI 可代用户下单购物
items.title_en: Walmart launches agent gateway to let AI shop and place orders for users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 22 日消息，沃尔玛于当地时间周三宣布，正式推出自有智能体网关，用于处理交易，并上线多项面向使用 AI 智能体的消费者的新功能，以此布局智能体电商。就在不久前，沃尔玛的头号竞争对手亚马逊开始拦截 AI 智能体替网购用户下单采购。 IT之家注意到，沃尔玛对 AI 技术的接纳态度，使其和其他线上商家形成区别。除亚马逊之外，不少旅游和预订网站面对越来越多消费者使用 AI 智能体的趋势，选择直接禁止智能体访问网站。而沃尔玛此前已经宣布和该领域头部智能体 Meta 的 Muse 达成合作，同时接入了 ChatGPT、Gemini 等热门 AI 应用。 沃尔玛总裁兼首席执行官约翰 · 弗纳（John Furner）周三在旧金山的 Masters of Scale 峰会上表示，如今沃尔玛正在加码相关技术布局，为 AI 智能体普及的时代做好准备。这套技术将同时支持沃尔玛及其折扣仓储门店山姆会员店的智能体购物。 核心是沃尔玛推出的智能体网关，这是该公司全新的 MCP 服务器，目的是让经过审核的智能体通过模型上下文协议（MCP）接入沃尔玛平台。该协议最初由 Anthropic 开发，能够让 AI 智能体对接外部数据源、工具和各类工作流程。在本次场景中，AI 智能体可以检索沃尔玛线上库存，并替用户完成下单。 此外，这家零售商称，通过智能体网关，消费者选购常用品牌或商品时，无需把个人信…
items.summary_en: Walmart unveiled its own agent gateway to handle transactions and new features for consumers using AI agents, betting on agentic commerce. The MCP server lets vetted agents access Walmart inventory and place orders for shoppers across Walmart and Sam’s Club. The move contrasts with Amazon’s blocking of agent orders and some travel sites’ bans, as Walmart partners with Meta’s Muse and integrates ChatGPT and Gemini.
items.why_zh: 零售巨头主动开放智能体交易入口，可能重塑AI代购的行业规则与平台竞争格局。
items.why_en: A retail giant is opening a transaction gateway for AI agents, potentially reshaping agentic commerce rules and platform competition.

items.title_zh: Meta 财报强劲股价大涨，拟发新股为 AI 支出融资
items.title_en: Meta stock surges on strong earnings report; tech giant unveils new shares to bankroll AI spending
items.summary_zh: Meta 在财报中交出强劲业绩，带动股价显著上涨；公司同时推出新股发行计划，用于为 AI 支出融资。投资者将强劲财报视为其核心业务仍具韧性，而新股安排则反映 AI 军备竞赛下资本开支压力上升。报道称，这家科技巨头正通过资本市场为高昂的 AI 基础设施和战略布局筹资。原文未披露发行规模、具体条款及资金分配细节。
items.summary_en: Meta stock surges on strong earnings report; tech giant unveils new shares to bankroll AI spending New York Post
items.why_zh: 强劲业绩与融资计划并行，显示即便现金牛业务稳健，AI 基建投入仍迫使科技巨头提前锁定资本。
items.why_en: Strong results alongside new fundraising show AI infrastructure costs are pushing even cash-rich tech giants to secure capital.

items.title_zh: Meta 将创设新一类股票，为 AI 战略融资
items.title_en: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
items.summary_zh: Meta 在周三发布的第三季度财报中宣布，将发行一类新的无投票权股票，为 AI 计划融资，并用于潜在收购和员工薪酬；该新股预计2027年开始交易。Meta 在新闻稿中称，在行业 AI 转型中，竞争、维持增长、扩展基础设施和推进新战略所需的投资规模巨大。CFO 苏珊·李在财报电话会上补充了相关安排。此举显示 Meta 正提前锁定长期资金，以支撑高强度的 AI 投入。
items.summary_en: Meta says it's issuing a new class of shares to fund its AI initiatives. As part of its third-quarter earnings report released on Wednesday , the company says the non-voting stock will also go toward potential acquisitions and employee compensation, with trading beginning in 2027. "The scale of investment required to compete, sustain growth, expand infrastructure, and pursue new strategic initiatives amidst the AI transformation taking place in the industry is significant," Meta says in the press release. Susan Li, Meta's chief financial officer, added during an earnings call that the new clas…
items.why_zh: 用无投票权新股为AI融资，可在不稀释控制权的同时筹集长期资本，或成为大型科技公司AI军备竞赛的融资样本。
items.why_en: Non-voting shares can raise long-term capital without diluting control, offering a possible financing template for Big Tech’s AI race.

items.title_zh: Walmart launches tools for AI agents to shop for customers
items.title_en: Walmart launches tools for AI agents to shop for customers

items.summary_en: Reuters reported that Walmart launched tools allowing AI agents to shop for customers, signaling its embrace of agentic commerce rather than restricting agent access like some platforms. Details on the tools’ form, availability and transaction mechanics were not disclosed. The move puts the balance between convenience, security and openness in focus.
items.why_zh: 主流零售商开始为AI智能体提供购物接口，将推动电商流量入口和交易方式发生变化。
items.why_en: A major retailer offering shopping interfaces to AI agents could shift e-commerce traffic and transaction models.

items.title_zh: 研究称 AI 模型或许没有研究者想象中那么神秘
items.title_en: AI Models May Be Less Mysterious Than Researchers Thought
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，AI 模型可能并不像研究者此前认为的那样神秘难解。若模型内部机制更可预测、更可分析，将有助于提升 AI 安全评估、审计和治理的可操作性，也为监管和部署前的风险检查提供更多抓手。原文标题未给出具体研究方法、覆盖模型或结论细节。该观点若成立，可能改变业界对模型可解释性难度的判断，但仍需结合完整研究审视。
items.summary_en: AI Models May Be Less Mysterious Than Researchers Thought BankInfoSecurity
items.why_zh: 模型可解释性直接关系到AI安全审计与监管，若“神秘性”被高估，治理路径可能随之调整。
items.why_en: Interpretability is central to AI safety auditing and regulation, so evidence that models are less opaque could reshape governance approaches.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet 智能体，对标 Meta Muse 与 OpenAI Dots
items.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent to rival Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet AI 智能体，加入与 Meta 的 Muse、OpenAI 的 Dots 竞争的行列。报道显示，主要 AI 公司正围绕能够代用户执行任务的智能体产品加速布局。原文未披露 Claude Duet 的具体功能、定价、上线地区或可用时间。智能体赛道竞争升温，也意味着平台接入、任务可靠性和安全边界将成为差异化关键。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent to rival Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots Anadolu Ajansı
items.why_zh: 又一头部厂商入局智能体产品，说明竞争正从模型能力转向可执行任务的代理平台。
items.why_en: Another leading lab entering the agent market shows competition shifting from model capability to task-executing agent platforms.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出主动式 AI 智能体 Claude Duet
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet, a Proactive AI Agent
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Anthropic 推出名为 Claude Duet 的 AI 智能体，主打“主动性”：它不再被动等待提问，而是主动为用户推送信息和提醒。该产品被定位为面向专业人士与中小企业的助手，将与 Meta、OpenAI 的同类智能体产品直接竞争。目前关于其具体能力与开放范围的细节仍有限，但此举显示 Anthropic 正从模型提供方向智能体应用层加速延伸。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet, a Proactive AI Agent MacRumors
items.why_zh: 这标志着 Anthropic 正式进军“主动式智能体”赛道，与 Meta、OpenAI 展开正面竞争。
items.why_en: It marks Anthropic's formal entry into the proactive-agent race, putting it in direct competition with Meta and OpenAI.

items.summary_en: Tesla reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $28.0 billion, roughly flat year over year, with gross profit up 8.7% and gross margin at 19.6%. Net income attributable to shareholders fell 43% to $787 million and operating margin dropped to 2.6%, even as deliveries hit a quarterly record and the company reached its 10 millionth vehicle delivery.
items.why_zh: 营收持平而利润大幅下滑，显示特斯拉在创纪录交付量下仍面临明显的盈利压力。
items.why_en: Flat revenue with sharply lower profit shows Tesla facing margin pressure despite record deliveries.

items.title_zh: Recursive 发布 Flint：一款可在笔记本本地运行的编程模型，号称主要由 AI 构建
items.title_en: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
items.summary_zh: Recursive 推出名为 Flint 的编程专用模型，可在笔记本电脑上本地运行，无需依赖云端算力。该公司称，这一模型在很大程度上由 AI 自身参与构建，体现了 AI 辅助开发 AI 的思路。若属实，这类小体积本地编程模型有望降低开发者的使用成本与数据外泄风险，也反映出模型小型化与本地化部署的趋势。

items.why_en: A capable local coding model could reduce developers' reliance on the cloud and improve code privacy.

items.summary_en: Meta reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $64.601 billion, up 26% year over year, and net income attributable to shareholders of $9.86 billion, up 264%. Gross margin slipped to 79.3%, while operating cash flow reached $32.786 billion. Meta said the results beat expectations as AI investments showed progress and core advertising remained strong.
items.why_zh: AI投入效果显现与广告业务强劲，推动Meta营收和利润双双超预期。
items.why_en: Meta’s AI investments and strong ad business drove revenue and profit above expectations.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet 智能体，对标 Meta 与 OpenAI
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet AI Agent to Take On Meta and OpenAI
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 AI 智能体 Claude Duet，直接对标 Meta 与 OpenAI 的同类产品。报道指出，这一定位为专业用户的智能体是 Anthropic 在模型之外向应用层扩展的重要动作，也让智能体赛道的竞争进一步升温。目前公开的产品细节仍然有限，其实际能力与商业模式有待后续披露。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet AI Agent to Take On Meta and OpenAI The Tech Buzz
items.why_zh: 头部模型厂商纷纷下场做智能体，意味着 AI 竞争正从模型能力转向产品与场景。
items.why_en: Top model makers entering the agent space shows AI competition shifting from raw model capability to products and use cases.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet 智能体，正面迎战 Meta Muse
items.title_en: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布推出智能体 Claude Duet，对标 Meta 的 Muse 与 OpenAI 的 Dots，面向专业人士和中小企业，以“研究预览”形式上线，提供 iOS、Android 独立应用及网页版 Claude 入口，底层基于 Claude Opus 5.5。据介绍，它每天早晨会推送一份简短简报，汇总已连接应用中的重要事项；全天持续关注这些应用，只在确有必要时才向用户发消息。目前该产品仍处于早期阶段，功能与开放范围可能随反馈调整。
items.summary_en: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic , and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web. items.why_zh: 以主动推送为核心的智能体形态，正在成为大模型厂商争夺的新入口。
items.why_en: Proactive, push-based agents are emerging as the next battleground for LLM vendors.

items.title_zh: Peter Law Group 成立人工智能与新兴技术业务部门
items.title_en: Peter Law Group Launches Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology Practice
items.summary_zh: 据 citybiz 报道，Peter Law Group 宣布设立人工智能与新兴技术业务部门，面向涉足 AI 及新兴技术的客户提供相关法律服务。此举反映出随着 AI 应用加速落地，企业在合规、知识产权与交易结构等方面的专业法律需求正在上升。报道未披露该部门的具体团队规模与业务细节。

items.why_zh: 律所专设 AI 业务线，说明 AI 合规与知识产权正成为企业刚性需求。
items.why_en: A dedicated AI practice shows AI compliance and IP are becoming must-haves for businesses.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元融资，宁德时代、腾讯领投
items.title_en: DeepSeek Completes About 100 Billion Yuan Round Led by CATL and Tencent
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元融资，宁德时代、腾讯领投 TradingView
items.summary_en: TradingView reports that DeepSeek has completed roughly 100 billion yuan in funding led by CATL and Tencent. Valuation, other participants and use of proceeds were not disclosed, and DeepSeek has not confirmed the round.
items.why_zh: 由电池巨头宁德时代与腾讯领投，显示出产业资本与互联网资本正加速涌入大模型领域。
items.why_en: Leadership by battery giant CATL and Tencent shows industrial and internet capital accelerating into large language models.
